title: Herby Crisp Saudi Arabian Lamb Kebabs
description: A low calorie Saudi Arabian dish featuring lamb kebabs marinated in extra virgin olive oil and cooked to a crisp in a terracotta dish, served with a side of fresh herbs and stone bowl dolsot.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, parsley, mint, garlic, lemon juice, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers in a terracotta dish and cook for 20 minutes, or until the lamb is cooked through and crispy on the outside.
Serve the lamb kebabs hot, garnished with additional parsley and mint if desired.
Cook the stone bowl dolsot according to package instructions and serve on the side.
Let the lamb kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
